# BTC-USD: research for 2026-08-19 close to 2026-09-24 close

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on BTC-USD daily closes from Yahoo Finance. I could not open the Yahoo history page (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BTC-USD/history/) because the proxy refused the connection, so I have not seen the official 2026-08-19 close.
- 2026-08-20: Yahoo Finance reported that BTC-USD opened at $69,289.44 on Aug 20. Yahoo's daily bars use UTC days, so this should be very close to the Aug 19 close, which works as an estimated baseline of about $69,300. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-august-20-2026-crypto-prices-surge-after-president-trump-pushes-for-clarity-act-154014757.html)
- 2026-08-19: Bitcoin was trading in the $64,300 to $64,900 range in the morning, then rallied to an intraday high of about $69,749. [Yahoo Aug 19](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-wednesday-august-19-2026-crypto-prices-rise-after-sec-announces-proposed-regulation-161733939.html), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-19-2026/), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/bitcoin-surges-8-amid-1b-short-squeeze-on-august-19)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet; the window runs another five weeks. On the morning of 2026-08-20, BTC was already about 3 to 4% above the estimated baseline:
- 2026-08-20: about $71,970 at 6:15 a.m. ET [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-20-2026/), and about $71,980 at 9:15 a.m. ET [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-august-20-2026-crypto-prices-surge-after-president-trump-pushes-for-clarity-act-154014757.html). One report had it up 3.48% to $71,505 on Aug 20. [GetLegalBrief](https://getlegalbrief.com/story/legal-bitcoin-clarity-act-sec-cftc-jurisdiction)
- 2026-08-20: Fortune puts the price about 37% below its level a year earlier (about $114,259). [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-20-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-20: Forbes reports that traders warn the $70,000 squeeze could be a "bull trap", with a downside target near $44,000. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/digital-assets/2026/08/20/bitcoin-suddenly-hits-70000-as-traders-warn-of-a-44000-bull-trap/)
- 2026-08-19/20: Trump pushed Congress at a White House event to pass a "fair version" of the CLARITY Act, which is stalled in the Senate. BTC moved above $70,000 for the first time since early June. Reported short liquidations range from about $1.4B in four hours to more than $3B over two days. [Brave New Coin](https://bravenewcoin.com/insights/bitcoin-hits-70000-as-trump-pushes-clarity-act-hyperliquid-surges-and-1-4-billion-in-shorts-get-wiped-out), [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-tops-72k-trump-backs-clarity-sec-crypto-rules/), [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/regulation/white-house-crypto-meeting-trump-pushes-clarity-act-as-bitcoin-above-70k/)
- 2026-08-19: The Treasury said it would double buybacks of long-duration debt, after a bond selloff pushed the 30-year yield to its highest level since 2007. [GetLegalBrief](https://getlegalbrief.com/story/legal-bitcoin-clarity-act-sec-cftc-jurisdiction)
- 2026-08-19: CoinDesk said BTC (about $66,500 at 11:22 a.m. EDT) was near a technical breakout with a possible target of about $76,000. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/19/bitcoin-nears-key-technical-breakout-that-could-propel-prices-to-usd76-000)
- 2026-08-18: The SEC published a 402-page proposed rulemaking, "Regulation Crypto Assets", which includes offering exemptions of up to $75M a year. [GetLegalBrief](https://getlegalbrief.com/story/legal-bitcoin-clarity-act-sec-cftc-jurisdiction)
- 2026-08-07: Deribit's DVOL index (30-day expected volatility) was near 35, down from a high of about 90 earlier in 2026. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/08/07/bitcoin-s-volatility-has-nearly-disappeared-the-risk-hasn-t)
- July 2026: US spot BTC ETFs took in a net +$172M, their first monthly inflow after two months of outflows. Year to date they show about -$5.3B, including about -$4.5B in June. [Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/markets/bitcoin-etfs-july-green-despite-late-month-selling)

## 4. Base rates
- The window is about 36 calendar days. Using √(36/365) ≈ 0.31:
  - At the early-August implied volatility of about 35%, one standard deviation is roughly ±11%.
  - At 45 to 55%, which is closer to BTC's longer-run realized volatility, it is roughly ±14 to 17%.
  - The question's range of -50 to +40 covers well beyond ±3 standard deviations at those levels.
- Volatility jumped on 2026-08-19 from very low levels, so the near-term distribution is probably wider than the early-August implied volatility suggests.
- Over the past year the trend has been down: about -37% year over year, and $70,000 had not been reached since June. The rally was driven mostly by liquidations and positioning, and squeezes like this sometimes partly reverse.
- I could not get a clean historical series of 36-day BTC returns for this period. Historically September has been a weak month for BTC on average, but that pattern is not a reliable signal.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-19: Polymarket's daily Aug 19 market resolved in the $68,000 to $70,000 bucket. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/bitcoin-price-on-august-19-2026)
- 2026-08-20: Reports on Polymarket's Aug 20 market conflict: one says it resolved ">$72,000", another mentions $75,000. Treat both with caution. [Lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/crypto/bitcoin-price-on-august-20-2026)
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for September 2026 or late September prices. Polymarket's "What price will Bitcoin hit in September" page is the place to check.
- Analyst views are split: CoinDesk's technical target is about $76,000, while traders quoted by Forbes see a possible bull trap toward $44,000.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Aug 27 to 29: the Jackson Hole symposium. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first keynote as chair on Aug 28, most sources say at 10:00 a.m. ET. [XTB](https://www.xtb.com/en/education/jackson-hole-2026-warsh-fed-speech), [Washington Examiner](https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/?p=4703956)
- Aug 28 or 29 (sources differ): a Deribit monthly BTC options expiry of about $6.4B, with a put-to-call ratio of 0.83, which could mean pinning or gamma effects. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/bitcoin-options-expiry-worth-6-4b-on-deribit-could-boost-volatility)
- Early to mid September: the August jobs report and CPI. I did not confirm the exact dates.
- Sep 15: a reported Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act, which needs 60 votes. Prediction markets reportedly price passage at about 19 to 24%. I only found this in an article dated after the cutoff, so it is not confirmed from in-window sources.
- Sep 15 to 16: the FOMC meeting. The target range is 3.50 to 3.75%. At the July meeting, three dissenters voted for a hike. A secondary source puts market odds at roughly 55 to 63% for a hold, 37 to 43% for a hike and about 1 to 2% for a cut, but I could not date or verify these figures. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/will-the-u-s-federal-reserve-fomc-announce-a)
- Late September: the SEC comment period on "Regulation Crypto Assets", plus ETF flows.

I have left out all sources dated after 2026-08-20.
